generated.description: A large theater-style build with a rounded, arched front and stepped terraces that rise in tiers from the center. It is made mostly of stone slabs, stone, cobblestone stairs, and grass blocks, with sandstone accents and a very large number of jack o'lantern blocks giving it a glowing Halloween look. The footprint is about 191 by 195 blocks, 79 blocks tall, with roughly 175,000 blocks total; the interior has no block entities listed.
